verdict.rationale: Alma is a technology-enabled immigration law firm that handles sensitive client data, so asking whether clients can keep their data out of AI training is a fair privacy-posture question. The evidence pack contains no privacy policy, opt-out, or training-data statement. The mention of 'case intelligence pulled from hundreds of prior filings' describes reuse of case data, not a user control to prevent it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
